name: TextReveal
description: A passage whose words come into full strength as you scroll it into view, or all together when it appears. The real text is always in the page.

children.description: The text. In line mode, each new line (a newline character) is one unit.

by.description: What is revealed one after another.

mode.description: scroll follows the scroll position; view plays once when the text comes into view.

minOpacity.description: How faint a unit is before it is revealed, from 0 to 1.

isPaused.description: Stops the animation and shows the finished text. Moving content that lasts more than five seconds should be stoppable.

requirements: The text is ordinary text in the page from the server render, readable with no JavaScript and read once by screen readers
Unrevealed text is faint but present; choose a minOpacity that keeps it legible if people may read ahead
Decoration only: the animated layers are hidden from assistive technology and never take focus
Stands still for visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion), and can also be shown still with the rdm-still class or isPaused
In forced-colors (high contrast) mode the text is drawn in the system colours
Does not flash: nothing changes more than three times in a second (WCAG 2.3.1)
Optional: it is a separate component, so projects that do not add it carry none of its code
screenReader: Read as ordinary text: the reveal is purely visual

use_when: A short statement or mission passage that builds as the page is scrolled
A quote that appears when it comes into view
avoid_when: Body text people must scan quickly
Content inside a region that never scrolls, with mode scroll
anti_patterns: A minOpacity of 0 for text people may need before it is revealed
